_note: This is the text/logic-only slice of the roadmap's 30-case golden set — the safety, calculation and retrieval cases that don't depend on real label photographs. The image-based clear/cropped-photo cases (Step 10) still need to be collected from real packaging by the team and scored the same way this file's cases are scored.
